import type { ComponentType } from 'react'

export type IconSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'
export type IconVariant = 'default' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info'

export interface IconProps {
  size?: IconSize
  variant?: IconVariant
  className?: string
}

const SIZE_MAP: Record<IconSize, number> = {
  xs: 14,
  sm: 16,
  md: 20,
  lg: 24,
  xl: 32,
}

const VARIANT_CLASSES: Record<IconVariant, string> = {
  default: 'text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400',
  primary: 'text-primary-700 dark:text-primary-700',
  success: 'text-success-600 dark:text-success-600',
  warning: 'text-warning-600 dark:text-warning-700',
  danger: 'text-error-600 dark:text-error-600',
  info: 'text-secondary-600 dark:text-secondary-700',
}

export function StandardIcon({
  icon: IconComponent,
  size = 'md',
  variant = 'default',
  className = '',
}: IconProps & { icon: ComponentType<{ className?: string; size?: number }> }) {
  const sizeValue = SIZE_MAP[size]
  const variantClass = VARIANT_CLASSES[variant]

  return (
    <IconComponent
      size={sizeValue}
      className={`${variantClass} ${className}`.trim()}
    />
  )
}

export type AIIconName = keyof typeof AIIcons

export function getAIIcon(name: AIIconName): ComponentType<{ className?: string; size?: number }> {
  return AIIcons[name] || Circle
}

export function renderIcon(
  name: AIIconName,
  props: IconProps & { icon?: never } = {},
) {
  const IconComponent = getAIIcon(name)
  return <StandardIcon icon={IconComponent} {...props} />
}
